title: Primer of the First Quiet
summary: A primer for the rare early-awakened Monarch whose young soul learns to meet a hostile flicker with its opposite and let both go out.

title: The Cancelling Handbook
summary: A handbook that teaches a new soul cultivator to read the shape of a hostile soul note and answer it with its exact opposite.

title: A Drill-Book of Opposite Notes
summary: A drill-book of small exercises in turning a note upside down and sounding it against its twin until both fall silent.

title: Handbook of the Still Soul
summary: A short handbook on keeping the soul so still that hostile force finds no motion to catch and nothing to hold.

title: Guide to the Counter Frequency
summary: A guide to finding the frequency of an incoming soul technique and sending back a counter frequency that cancels it.

title: The Zero Point Primer
summary: A primer on the zero point where a hostile force and its answer sum to nothing and the soul is left untouched.
